# Specify a feature (Rudolf S.)

Turns a short brief into requirements, a solution design and an implementation plan.

- Source: https://github.com/rsmdt/the-startup
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rsmdt/the-startup/main/plugins/start/skills/specify/SKILL.md
- Author: Rudolf S.
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/specify-a-feature-rudolf-s-4f3c8f1d

Claude starts by listing what it needs to know and the assumptions it would otherwise make, and asks you to confirm or correct them. It then researches the codebase and writes three documents: requirements, a target solution design and an implementation plan broken into slices for the companion /implement skill. Assumptions stay marked in the documents until confirmed.

**Try asking:**
- "/specify add team billing with per-seat pricing"
- "/specify a CSV import for contacts"
- "/specify rate limiting for the public API"

**Source:** [rsmdt/the-startup](https://github.com/rsmdt/the-startup/tree/HEAD/plugins/start/skills/specify) · MIT · by Rudolf S.
